title: Private deployment install storyboards and operator onboarding tiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and produce a coherent set of visual assets for Private/VPC onboarding focused on operator-first flows. This ticket covers end-to-end storyboards, tiled quickstart assets for the Console and docs, an animated CLI install sequence (GIF + frame export), and an upgrade modal visual that surfaces compatibility warnings and automatic rollback options. Deliverables must support both cloud VPC and on-prem air-gapped installs and include versions for light/dark console themes.
deliverables: 4 hero storyboard panels illustrating network onboarding journey (SVG + PNG)
Animated CLI walkthrough (5 frames exported + looping GIF + Figma prototype link)
Console quickstart tiles (3 sizes: 320, 768, 1280 px) showing 'Provision VPC', 'Install Appliance', 'Verify Connectivity'
Upgrade modal visuals: compatibility checklist, estimated downtime indicator, one-click rollback CTA
Edge case overlays: offline bootstrap, proxy setup, KMS integration note
Accessible alt text and copy variations for docs (short and long)
Exported asset package and a README with usage guidelines
assets_required: console mock screenshots with placeholder telemetry data
annotated source frames for engineering handoff
acceptance_criteria: Storyboards review approved by PM (Riley Chen) and Eng lead (Priya Singh)
Assets exported and uploaded to Drive path: https://drive.redwood.com/team/design/private-onboarding/2025-03-04
CLI animation passes accessibility motion guidelines (reduced motion variant included)
Upgrade modal copy validated with Legal and Security; sensitive inventory info redacted
Design tokens used (colors/spacing) match console-2025 theme; dark-mode variants included
Implementation notes attached with CSS/spacing specs and SVG optimization tips
progress_notes: 2025-02-18: Kickoff - aligned on scope with PM/Engineering. Decided to combine cloud-VPC and air-gapped variants in one asset set to reduce duplicated work.
2025-02-21: Exploratory sketches completed. Chosen visual language: simplified topology diagrams + operator-centric narratives (installer, validator, monitor).
2025-02-25: Prototype: Figma frames for CLI animation uploaded. Feedback: slow down blink timings; include reduced-motion alternative.
2025-02-28: Tech sync with infra team. Action: add a 'mirror registry' overlay for air-gapped flow and a separate step showing KMS key rotation during upgrade.
2025-03-02: First dev-handoff created. Included SVGs and a short README describing token usage and where to plug in telemetry mock data.
2025-03-04: Design review meeting. PM requested stronger emphasis on 'verify connectivity' step; Eng asked to annotate fallback network paths for partial connectivity scenarios.
review_feedback: Riley Chen (PM): 'Make the verify step explicit with a success/failure microflow so customers know remediation steps.'
Priya Singh (Eng): 'Ensure upgrade modal shows node-level compatibility matrix and a clear backout plan — include link to upgrade runbook.'
Security (Ethan Moore): 'Remove any sample API keys from screenshots; show KMS placeholder and state that customer keys are never exported.'
Design (Lead - Mei Wong): 'Simplify hero illustrations to three focal areas: Network Topology, Installer, Upgrade. Avoid overloaded diagrams.'
Accessibility (Lena Ortiz): 'Provide alt text and ensure color contrast meets AA for all chart elements.'
notes_for_engineering: SVGs should be delivered with descriptive IDs to allow runtime theming (data-theme attributes).
CLI animation frames are split into numbered PNGs to be consumed by the docs renderer that supports stepwise playback.
Provide a reduced-motion toggle binding to the user's prefers-reduced-motion media query.
Upgrade modal copy should be parameterized to include estimated downtime computed client-side; include an event hook for 'start-upgrade' and 'rollback' events.
Annotate where to mask customer-specific data in screenshots (IP ranges, account IDs) and provide a redaction macro sample (see PR #4621).
final_notes: After final approvals, export package must be uploaded to Drive and the release notes entry created by PM. Schedule a short demo for Customer Success to walk through the visuals for customer-facing onboarding emails. Follow security checklist before marking done.
qa_checks: All assets load in Console mock at 320/768/1280 breakpoints
Dark mode variants match color tokens and have correct contrast
GIF animation has reduced-motion alternative and does not auto-loop when prefers-reduced-motion is set
Upgrade modal renders correctly with localized copy (strings provided by i18n team)
